instruction: Add a splintered wooden ship mast with deep-carved, jagged grain patterns to the back.
Add a jagged, skeletal Hollow mask with long, curved horns to the carriage front.
Add segmented mechanical legs and a retractable robotic head to the base.
Add a carved sun-lion figurehead and a large, woven straw hat canopy.
Add three thick, chunky, oversized mechanical spider legs with exaggerated, beveled joints.
Add a floating shattered stone greatsword bound in layered, frayed fabric strips.
Add a segmented, robotic bracelet with carved Cybertronian geometric runes to the wrist.
Add a chunky, faceted geometric whale tail rudder with exaggerated sharp edges.
